header.running_head: The Condition of the Sahabah (RA) when Rasulullaah ﷺ Passed away and Their Weeping at their Separation from Him

blocks.text: Sahabah (RA) were all whispering to each other. Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) instructed his slave to listen to what they were saying and report back to him. The slave reported that he overheard the Sahabah (RA) saying that Rasulullaah ﷺ had passed away. Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) then hurried as he said, "O dear! My back has been broken!" (He was so overcome with grief that) The Sahabah (RA) thought that he would not even make it to the Masjid, but he did.[^1]

Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Abbaas (RA) narrates that on the day Rasulullaah ﷺ passed away, Hadhrat Abu Bakr Siddeeq (RA) emerged (from Rasulullaah ﷺ's room) as Hadhrat Umar (RA) was busy addressing the Sahabah (RA). He told Hadhrat Umar (RA) to be seated and after duly praising Allaah, he said, "Whoever worshipped Muhammad ﷺ should know that Muhammad ﷺ has passed away. On the other hand, whoever worships Allaah should know that Allaah is Alive and shall never die. Verily Allaah states:

blocks.arabic_text: وَمَا مُحَمَّدٌ اِلَّا رَسُوْلٌ قَدْ خَلَتْ مِنْ قَبْلِهِ الرُّسُلُ اَفَاۡئِنْ مَّاتَ اَوْ قُتِلَ انْقَلَبْتُمْ عَلٰٓى اَعْقَابِكُمْ وَمَنْ يَّنْقَلِبْ عَلٰى عَقِبَيْهِ فَلَنْ يَّضُرَّ اللّٰهَ شَيْئًا وَسَيَجْزِي اللّٰهُ الشّٰكِرِيْنَ
blocks.text: Muhammad ﷺ is but a Rasool (of Allaah). Indeed many Rusul have passed before him. If he passes away or is martyred, would you (Muslims) then turn back on your heels (and forsake Islaam)? He who turns back on his heels can never harm Allaah in the least (because he will be harming only himself). Allaah shall soon reward the grateful ones (so be firm and strive for His Deen).

Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Abbaas (RA) says, "By Allaah! (Because they were so overcome with grief) It was as if the people never knew that such a verse was ever revealed until Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) recited it. They all took it from Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) and every one of them was reciting it. Hadhrat Umar bin Khattaab (RA) said, 'By Allaah! No sooner did I hear Abu Bakr (RA) recite the verse when my legs collapsed beneath me and were unable to carry me. I then fell to the ground when I heard it for I was then convinced that Rasulullaah ﷺ had definitely passed away.'"[^2]

Hadhrat Uthmaan bin Affaan (RA) says, "When Rasulullaah ﷺ passed away, the Sahabah (RA) were so grieved that some of them even started having false thoughts (that Islaam had come to an end). I was also amongst those who were deeply grieved and was once sitting on one of the hills of Madinah when Umar (RA) passed by me without me even noticing that he had passed. By then, people had already pledged their allegiance to Abu Bakr (RA). Umar (RA)
Ibn Khusru, as quoted in Kanzul Ummaal (Vol.4 Pg.48).
Abdur Razzaaq, Ibn Sa'd, Ibn Abi Shaybah, Ahmad, Bukhaari, Ibn Hibbaan and others, as quoted in Kanzul Ummaal (Vol.4 Pg.48).
